added: English free text, Caller's Companion English imports and Re-check unrecognized figures now read more callers' wordings as English figures: P and N for partner and neighbor, "First corners trade by right", "Pass P by L", "All Partner Set", "Ones Partner right-hand turn 1.5", "Partner Set Right and Left advancing", "Lines of three go forward and back" and "1s cross and go below". A detail a figure has no option for, such as "forward" in "Turn single right forward", is kept as the figure's note.

The ECD line grammar (`parseEcdFigureLine`) reads `trade`, `pass X by <side>`, a leading `all`/`everyone` or a couple's `partner` before the dancers, `set right and left`, `go forward and back`, `go below` and P/N shorthand, reads a change of places' shoulder as its `hand` (the side passed), and keeps a turn single's `forward` and a cast's follower as the figure's note.
